# Find and replace text

Replace a word or phrase across one slide or the whole deck, keeping formatting.

## Inputs

Take these from the user's request (ask if a required one is missing):

- `<find>` (required): The text to find.
- `<replace>` (required): The replacement text.
- `<scope>`: "deck" (default) or a slide reference. Default: deck.

Replace "<find>" with "<replace>" (scope: <scope>).

`text_replace` (planned, not available yet) will do this in one call. Until
then:

1. Read the slides in scope with `query_slide` and list every text box and
   table cell whose text contains the phrase. Watch for case and for the
   phrase being split across formatting runs.
2. Replace each occurrence with `text_format`-safe edits: use `text_set`
   with the rich form built from the object's current runs, changing only
   the matched characters, so bold/colour/size around it survive.
   Table cells are addressed with `target.cell`.
3. Batch all edits into one `ops_apply` so the whole replacement is one
   step to revert.
4. Report how many occurrences you replaced on which slides, and any you
   skipped on purpose (e.g. a different meaning, a brand name).
